hypothesis: A 12-thread CTA tests a smaller legal block than the current 16-thread configuration while preserving one thread per target. It creates more CTAs but leaves many warp lanes inactive, so any effect on scheduling and total runtime must be measured rather than assumed.
notes: The kernel and its traversal, force equations, and memory strategy are unchanged. Supplied measurements show the one-thread parent was slower than baseline, while a 24-thread candidate was slightly faster; neither establishes how 12 threads will perform. Controller correctness checks and timings should determine the result.
